outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial tissue image with cluster overlays (micrograph), not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows H&E micrographs with spatial gene-expression overlays; these are spatial maps/micrographs, not summary bar/line plots requiring individual data points.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold-change values (a summary statistic) for each gene, comparing Tmprss11b-high vs low tumors, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
